description: This file defines a class `CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler` that manages communication between a WebView's JavaScript context and native Swift code, handling specific UI actions related to the Canvas. It includes network URL validation, message processing, and dispatching actions over network sessions.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: A final class that conforms to `WKScriptMessageHandler` to handle specific JavaScript messages within a WKWebView, primarily for processing user actions on a Canvas interface.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Determines if a given URL points to a local network resource, based on URL scheme and host/IP address.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the message handler with a session key.

methods.name: userContentController(_:didReceive:)
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from JavaScript, processes action data, and dispatches tasks accordingly, including sending messages over network/session.
